name: Netto no Shishou: Bernd
source: The plot revolves around Bernd, who moved to Berlin with his mother Dorothea and sister Laura against his will. One day, however, Bernd posts Bernd's personal data on /b/ and shortly thereafter Bernd receives an email asking him to meet another Bernd to save Krautchan.
translation: The plot revolves around Bernd, who moved to Berlin with his mother Dorothea and sister Laura against his will. One day, however, Bernd posts Bernd's personal data on /b/ and shortly thereafter Bernd receives an email asking him to meet another Bernd to save Krautchan.
